# Issue templates

This directory contains structured bug and feature forms plus the free-form question template shown by GitHub when a contributor opens an issue.

GitHub's issue chooser depends on the filenames and front matter here; changes should preserve the prompts needed to reproduce bugs or evaluate proposed work.

Contribution expectations begin in the root [README](../../README.md), while repository decisions and follow-ups belong in the locations defined by [`docs/worker-protocol.md`](../../docs/worker-protocol.md).
